name: SHIP OR DIE

sources.title: Homepage — 'Stop building. Start shipping. Public accountability platform for indie hackers to ship, track, and grow their projects.' (client-rendered SPA, Supabase)
Leaderboard — batch-provided submission URL; renders the same SPA shell, content not readable without JS
Firsto launch-sites listing — describes SHIP OR DIE as 'subscription-based accountability platform... requiring a paid membership' (DR 11, ~18.6K visits/mo)

requirements: Not a listing directory — it is a public accountability platform where indie hackers ship, track, and grow projects (leaderboard, project tracking, 'roast my startup' feature at /roast/startup)
Third-party reports membership is paid subscription — the model is intentionally gated to keep the community serious
SPA requires JavaScript; account creation is presumably via Supabase auth
preparation: An account (signup flow inside the SPA)
A project to register/track — name, URL, description, shipping milestones
Paid membership per third-party reporting (price unverifiable without rendering the app)
workflow: Open https://shipordie.club/ in a JS-capable browser and create an account
Register the project, pay any membership fee shown
Post shipping updates/milestones — public accountability feed and leaderboard placement is the 'listing'
Optional: use the /roast/startup feature for an AI roast of the startup (observed in third-party coverage)
watchFor: This is an accountability community, not exposure infrastructure — value is public building-in-public proof, not a backlink
Entire app is client-rendered; membership pricing and submit mechanics could not be verified firsthand
Batch-reported 'submissionUrl' (/leaderboard) is just the public leaderboard route, not a submission form
Small DR-11 site; audience is fellow indie hackers
countsAsLive: The project appears on the public shipordie.club leaderboard/feed with its shipping updates
unknowns: Exact membership price and whether any free tier exists
Whether projects get dofollow outbound links
Activity level — member counts and posting volume are not publicly readable
